meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会当领队,让 5 位互相敌对的评审(怀疑者、验证者、研究者、架构师、创意者)交叉攻击规划,只保留经得起批驳的结论,再交给 plan 代理编成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你要求做高严谨度的规划,或说出「hyperplan」「hpp」「/hyperplan」等触发词时启动。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member adversarial team whose members attack each other's findings. It distills only the insights that survive the cross-critique, then mandatorily passes them to the plan agent to formalize an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when planning needs high rigor, or when you say triggers like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', etc.

say_en.text: hyperplan: help me plan the launch steps for this project.
say_en.note: Triggers the 5 adversarial reviewers and generates a plan.
